slides: Circles, the advanced level. In the last lessons we learned the basic rules of the circle, and we practiced basic questions and harder ones.

slides.say: In fact, you already have the tools for most circle questions on the exam. Now we'll practice harder questions, the kind that come near the end of the section.
We'll meet a few ideas that come back again and again in these questions. The first one is shaded areas. We'll ask which shape minus which shape gives the shaded part.
at: The first one is shaded areas

slides.say: The second one is a shape inside a circle, or a circle inside a shape. There we'll write every length with the radius of the circle.
at: The second one is a shape

slides.say: We'll also see quick exam ways. We'll stop halfway and look at the choices, we'll plug in a number instead of a letter, and we'll estimate sizes. With them we can solve these questions much faster, and sometimes even when we're not sure of the full solution.

slides: We'll explain each one in the question that uses it. Let's start. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next video.
